Projects.title: VANGUARD - Fleet Control Tower
desc: Designed and developed a real-time Fleet Control Tower for dispatchers and supervisors, covering vehicle monitoring, task management, geofencing, incident handling, trip history, evidence, and operational reporting.
Built the Next.js 14 and TypeScript frontend plus a Python FastAPI backend with REST APIs, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL or SQLite, WebSocket live updates, Leaflet mapping, and Docker.

Delivered 14 functional modules and 13 report types, including live monitoring, Task Monitor, vehicle and driver registries, history replay, accident logs, camera evidence, dashcam monitoring, and report generation.
Projects.summary: A real-time Fleet Control Tower for dispatchers and supervisors spanning 14 operational modules and 13 report types.
Projects.impact: Centralized fleet monitoring, task management, geofencing, incident handling, trip history, evidence, and operational reporting.
highlights: Implemented real-time vehicle tracking, route visualization, speeding, geofence, and GPS-delay alerts.
Built the Next.js 14 and TypeScript frontend with a Python FastAPI backend.
Delivered 14 functional modules and 13 operational report types.

Projects.title: WhatsApp-Based Issue Reporting & Analytics Dashboard
desc: Developed the AI chatbot and backend integration for a WhatsApp-based issue-reporting system used with TRAMOS, covering message flows, intent detection, issue classification, knowledge-base troubleshooting, and automated escalation.
Built a workflow that collects required issue information, generates structured support tickets, integrates with osTicket through REST APIs, and notifies support operators by email.

Implemented the backend with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, WhatsApp Gateway and webhooks, AI and LLM services, Docker and VPS deployment, with conversation and ticket data feeding an analytics dashboard.
Projects.summary: AI-assisted WhatsApp issue reporting, structured ticket automation, and operational analytics integrated with TRAMOS.
Projects.impact: Replaced issue reporting through a single administrator with structured intake, troubleshooting, escalation, ticket creation, and operator notification.
highlights: Implemented intent detection, issue classification, knowledge-base troubleshooting, and escalation.
Integrated structured ticket creation with osTicket REST APIs and email notifications.
Connected conversation and ticket data to an analytics dashboard for operational monitoring.

Projects.title: EduIntel - Data Science Bootcamp Project
desc: Developed a web-based system to detect student performance issues using machine learning algorithms, specifically the Random Forest classifier. This system helps educators identify students who are at risk of underperformance early in the academic term.

Integrated interactive dashboards and model testing interface for practical use by educators. The system enables teachers to upload student data and receive predictions on performance issues, allowing for more targeted early intervention.
Helped improve early intervention strategies in student learning, enabling more targeted support and potentially better academic outcomes for at-risk students.
Projects.summary: Machine learning web system for detecting student performance issues with a Random Forest classifier.
Projects.impact: Supported early intervention decisions by turning student data into performance-risk predictions.
highlights: Built a model testing interface for educators.
Implemented Random Forest classification for performance issue detection.
Connected dashboard workflows with practical student support use cases.

Projects.title: Duplicate Data Detection Tool

Successfully deployed at PT Jababeka Tbk to streamline data validation processes and improve data integrity across business operations.

Projects.impact: Reduced manual data-quality review by providing a dedicated duplicate-detection workflow.
